constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames

constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)

sentences.ar: لما نيجي نبني النموذج بقى احنا فعلياً بنختار شكل المسطرة اللي هنقيس بيها
sentences.en: When we get to building the model, we are actually choosing the shape of the ruler we will measure with.

sentences.ar: عندنا أربع عائلات رئيسية للنماذج
sentences.en: We have four main families of models.

sentences.ar: الـlinear بيرسم خط مستقيم وسهل يتشرح
sentences.en: Linear draws a straight line and is easy to explain.

sentences.ar: الـtree بيقسم البيانات على عتبات
sentences.en: Tree splits the data on thresholds.

sentences.ar: الـensemble بياخد متوسطات قوية زي random forest وده دايما بيكتسح على الداتا الجدولية
sentences.en: Ensemble takes strong averages, like random forest, and it always sweeps on tabular data.

sentences.ar: والمسير للاهتمام هنا إن الـkNN لما تكون قيمة k فيه بتساوي 1 بيدي خطأ تدريب صفر بالبناء
sentences.en: And the interesting thing here is that kNN, when the value of k equals 1, gives zero training error by construction.

sentences.ar: وده فخ تاني لازم ناخد بالنا منه
sentences.en: And that is another trap we have to watch out for.

sentences.ar: عشان كده أهم حاجة هي ضرورة اختيار عائلة النموذج قبل ما نعمل أي fitting
sentences.en: That is why the most important thing is the necessity of choosing the model family before we do any fitting.

sentences.ar: هل دايماً الـaccuracy أو الدقة العالية بتكون دليل قاطع على النجاح؟
sentences.en: Is accuracy, that is a high accuracy figure, always conclusive proof of success?

sentences.ar: يعني لو عندنا classifier حقق دقة 99%
sentences.en: I mean, if we have a classifier that achieved 99% accuracy.

sentences.ar: هل ده معناه وإحنا مغمضين إنه النموذج ممتاز وجاهز للاستخدام؟
sentences.en: Does that mean, with our eyes closed, that the model is excellent and ready to use?

sentences.ar: الحقيقة إن الأرقام أحياناً بتكون خدعة جداً وممكن تخفي وراها فشل كارثي
sentences.en: The truth is that numbers are sometimes a trick and can hide a catastrophic failure behind them.

sentences.ar: عشان نفهم الخدعة دي خلينا نبص على الـconfusion matrix
sentences.en: To understand this trick, let's look at the confusion matrix.

sentences.ar: تخيلوا عندنا داتا نسبة الحالات الإيجابية فيها 1% بس
sentences.en: Imagine we have data where the proportion of positive cases is only 1%.

sentences.ar: النموذج هنا يقدر يحقق accuracy 99% ببساطة عن طريق إنه دايماً يقول لأ أو سلبي على كل حاجة
sentences.en: The model can achieve 99% accuracy simply by always saying no, or negative, on everything.

sentences.ar: النتيجة هتكون إيه؟ 0 true positives
sentences.en: What would the result be? Zero true positives.

sentences.ar: وعشان كده لما الـaccuracy تكون مضللة بالشكل ده بنلجأ لمقاييس التقييم الحقيقية
sentences.en: And that is why, when accuracy is misleading like this, we resort to the real evaluation metrics.

sentences.ar: المقاييس دي هي اللي بتدينا الصورة الحقيقية فعلاً لأداء النموذج
sentences.en: These metrics are what give us the truly real picture of the model's performance.

sentences.ar: عشان يدينا في النهاية تقييم صادق وموثوق نقدر نعتمد عليه
sentences.en: So that it gives us in the end an honest and reliable evaluation we can depend on.

sentences.ar: وهنا بنوصل لمعضلة الـbias والـvariance
sentences.en: And here we reach the bias and variance dilemma.

sentences.ar: زي ما احنا شايفين على الشمال عندنا بكثير حدود من الدرجة التالتة
sentences.en: As we see, on the left we have a polynomial of the third degree.

sentences.ar: وعلى اليمين بكثير حدود من الدرجة التاسعة
sentences.en: And on the right a polynomial of the ninth degree.

sentences.ar: اللحظة اللي المنحنين بيفترقوا فيها دي هي اللحظة للنموذج بيبدأ فيها يحفظ الداتا بدل ما يفهمها
sentences.en: The moment the two curves diverge is the moment the model starts memorizing the data instead of understanding it.

sentences.ar: في نهاية الرحلة التقنية الطويلة دي الأثر الحقيقي والأمين اللي بنطلع به هو سجل التجربة أو الـ Experiment Record الموثق
sentences.en: At the end of this long technical journey, the real and honest artifact we walk away with is the documented experiment record.

sentences.ar: السجل ده بيضم ست خطوات واضحة جداً بيبدأ من الـ Baseline Score
sentences.en: This record includes six very clear steps; it starts with the baseline score.

sentences.ar: وبعدين طريقة الـ Split واختيار الـmetric المظبوط ومبرره
sentences.en: Then the split method and choosing the right metric along with its justification.

sentences.ar: لحد ما نوصل لنتيجة الـ Held Out وتحليل الـfailure Cases
sentences.en: Until we reach the held-out result and the analysis of the failure cases.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً القرار النهائي بخصوص النموذج ده
sentences.en: And finally the final decision regarding this model.

sentences.ar: بنختم الشرح ده بالسؤال الاستفزازي ده
sentences.en: We close this explainer with this provocative question.

sentences.ar: هل النموذج اللي مبني وما تقيمش تقييم أمين وصارم يعتبر فعلا أي حاجة أكتر من مجرد demo أو عرض توضيحي؟
sentences.en: Does a model that is built but not evaluated honestly and rigorously count as anything more than a mere demo, or illustrative show?

sentences.ar: الإجابة واضحة جدا التقييم هو اللي بيفصل بين الشغل الحقيقي والمجرد استعراض
sentences.en: The answer is very clear: evaluation is what separates real work from mere showing off.

sentences.ar: في الشرح الجاي هنكمل الرحلة دي وندخل فعالة من
sentences.en: In the next explainer we will continue this journey and enter...

sentences.ar: ونشوف إزاي القواعد دي بتتطور في النماذج الأكبر استنونا
sentences.en: and see how these rules evolve in the bigger models. Stay tuned.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

first_mention_gloss.gloss_ar: إن معلومة من المستقبل دخلت التدريب

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A hierarchical structure of nodes with one root and child branches, no cycles; used for i…
concepts.failure: Letting a tree become unbalanced, so lookups degrade toward a linear walk.

concepts.def_en: Combining many models, such as the trees in a random forest, and averaging or voting their predictions for a more accurate, stable result.
concepts.def_ar: الـensemble إنك تجمع موديلات كتير، زي الـtrees في random forest، وتاخد متوسط توقعاتها أو تصويتها لنتيجة أدق وأثبت.
concepts.failure: Assuming an ensemble always wins; it adds cost and cannot fix leakage or bad features.

concepts.def_en: An ensemble of many decision trees trained on random samples, whose predictions are averaged or voted, usually stronger than one tree.
concepts.def_ar: الـrandom forest مجموعة decision trees كتير متدرّبة على عينات عشوائية، وبناخد متوسط توقعاتها أو تصويتها، وغالباً أقوى من tree واحدة.
concepts.failure: Expecting a forest to be as readable as a single tree.

concepts.def_en: k-nearest neighbours: predicts for a new point by looking at its k closest training points and taking their majority or average.
concepts.def_ar: الـkNN بيتنبأ لنقطة جديدة بإنه يبص على أقرب k نقطة من داتا التدريب ويختار الأغلبية أو المتوسط بتاعهم.
concepts.failure: Reading zero training error at k=1 as quality; it merely memorises the data.

concepts.def_en: A table of predicted versus actual classes, counting true and false positives and negativ…
concepts.failure: Trusting high accuracy on imbalanced data when the matrix shows no real cases caught.

concepts.def_en: The simplest reasonable reference result, such as a naive rule, average or timing before…
concepts.failure: Reporting a model's score without a baseline, so a trivial rule might score the same.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Bars (single or stacked) with token colours; values carry refs.
A deck dealt into train/validation/test splits (seeded).
A threshold handle on a scale; zones flip state as it moves.
